Favoured weapon: Dart

Granted power: Aura of Courage also gives Advantage on saves against charm. Once/day, as an action: you and every ally within 30ft end the Frightened condition and gain Advantage on saves against fear and charm for the encounter.

Allegiance: Chaotic Good, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Lliira in the World of Arneyan wiki.
